title: app-crm: synonyms for the cross-language words its ask scenarios use
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic). The maintainer set who files this epic's cards, in this session's chat, 2026-11-17, verbatim: 「你应该负责立卡，对方只是派发处理」. The gap was reported to this session by the dispatching seat `repo:objectstack#3` on #34659 (comment 6946578317); the filer did not re-read the code behind it.

## Why

After the #34720 ruling a Chinese word reaches an English-labelled member only as an authored synonym, and `candidates` compares strings, so it will not rescue a word in another language. The reference app's ask scenarios use such words.

## Evidence

- `examples/app-crm/src/datasets/opportunity.dataset.ts` carries synonyms for some members; #34687's cards ask with words it may not list.
- Ruling on #34720: bundle labels in the caller's locale, other languages by synonym.

## Scope

- Each cross-language word #34687's cards ask with is a declared synonym of exactly one member of `crm_opportunity_metrics`, or the card is corrected.
- File surface: `examples/app-crm/src/datasets/**`, its smoke test.

## Done when

- #34687's round shows no zero-match on a word that has one right member.

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Related: #34687, #34718, objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2593.
